introHtml: Ariel outdoor blankets offer a premium way to promote your brand at outdoor events, company picnics, or trade shows. Made from durable fleece and featuring water-resistant backing, these blankets combine comfort with practicality. Options like the Sand Repellent Blanket or Roll-Up Picnic Blanket make them ideal for beach days or stadium seating. Choose from plaid patterns or solid colors, and add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a memorable giveaway that recipients will use season after season.
